pattern: B <type> <size> <casing><output shaft> [<output flange>] <ratio> <input dims> <output dims> <mounting position> [accessories]
note: Chart on PDF p17 is an image; field order read from it. Casing letter + output-shaft letter combine, e.g. FC = foot mounting + C hollow shaft.

segments.name: type

values.PB: gearmotor fitted for motor mounting with flexible coupling (PAM-type input with elastic coupling); not for size 063
values.B: gearmotor fitted for motor coupling (PAM) - IEC B5/B11 motor flange
values.CB: compact gearmotor (motor directly flanged; B10/B11 compact motor versions)

segments.aluminium_series_prefix: BA = aluminium series: CBA compact motor, BA PAM motor-coupling, IBA input shaft

segments.name: output_shaft_version
segments.availability: Sizes A42-A52-A53 are not available in versions D-S-P (p16). Aluminium series: foot mounting only (A40/A50/A70 pages 18); cast iron 063-123: F/S/U; 143-163: F and U only per p19-21 (S flange: 063-123).

segments.name: input_dimensions
segments.description: PAM motor-coupling flange PmxDm (e.g. 160x14) or ECE input shaft diameter

segments.name: output_dimensions
segments.description: output shaft/bore dimension, e.g. 250x28 (free field in chart)

segments.name: mounting_position
segments.note: p22 shows the six positions B3,B6,B7,B8,V5,V6 pictorially; meaning of V5/V6 orientation as drawn (V5 motor up, V6 motor down).

segments.name: terminal_box_position
segments.note: p22; supplied in position 1 unless specified

segments.name: accessories
segments.description: torque arm, output shaft cover, backstop, shrink disc, reinforced seals, mounting kit, machine axis (section 4)

direction_of_rotation: p24: standard rotation as in diagram; opposite rotation on request except BA42-BA52-BA53
